title: Rav Ami bar Chiyya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman writes that in Zevachim 108b he asks Rabbi Zeira. In the readings he cites from Shitah Mekubbetzet and Dikdukei Soferim the name is Rabbi Avin bar Chiyya. In [Avodah Zarah 51b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.51b.15), the name is Rav Assi bar Chiyya.[^1]

notes.text: In the consulted [Zevachim 105b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.105b.10-12), Rabbi Zeira asks Rabbi Ami bar Chiyya or, in the alternative reading, Rabbi Avin bar Kahana. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=594&lang=en) also places Rabbi Zeira’s question at 105b and wonders whether one of the Ami/Assi forms is a scribal error. Hyman’s reported editions and the identity of their bearers remain separate questions.
